objective: Independent recent-fit contract RF1 for main line 1 (owner instruction 2026-10-01 ~09:55 UTC: screen for fitness to the current market; 2024-01..2026-06 and 2026-07..now, or market phases; passing strategies go to paper, two weeks confirm execution). Judge the same multi-signal, risk-controlled, cost-aware U3000 book as t20261001_book_v1 under amendment A1 run conventions on window A 2024-01-08..2026-06-30 (research_pass >= 1.19, watch_recent >= 0.87 median-offset net Sharpe), a not-broken check on 2026-07-01..09-17, leave-one-phase-out, net-and-gross placebo, beta, solver and 2x-cost conditions, with the 2017-2023 stress window as a crash diagnostic; and test whether volatility-state timing (M0V) or the cached T-19 model theme (M0X) adds over M0.
target_regime_and_horizon: US equities U3000/P1000 per t20261001_book_v1; weekly rebalancing, 5 offsets, median; fill at the close of t+1. Target regime: the 2024-01..2026-09 market (11 phases from SPY >= 7% drawdown cuts, reports/research/program/regimes-2026-10-01), currently up_mid (SPY above its 200-day mean, VIX 14.46-20.60). Validity to 2026-12-31, then forward review; failure signals and exit rules in hypotheses.md section 7.
existing_solution_comparison: Professional systematic long/short equity funds net Sharpe median 0.51 and 90th percentile 1.18 (AQR/HFR 1996-2023); JKMP Portfolio-ML net 1.38 for a $10B large-cap investor; Chen-Velikov: single anomalies net about 4 bp/month post-2005, combinations about 20 bp. Off-the-shelf tooling is reused (cvxpy + Clarabel; skfolio only as a cross-check; JKMP's code is too heavy at about 75 GB, so a reduced version). No public record covers this universe, cost model and the 2024-26 window, so the run is needed. Our standalone long-only anomaly tests (263 directions, 3 passed) and the T-19 model books are the negative baseline; the Stage 0 hedged books (P1000 8-book combo anchor 0.58, stress -0.23) are contaminated diagnostics, not results. Factor timing evidence: Fan et al. 2022 (Financial Review) find factor momentum does not beat buy-and-hold of the same factors; Neuhierl-Randl-Reschenhofer-Zechner 2023 find timing gains of about 2% a year per factor, with past returns and volatility the best single predictors -- hence a volatility-state variant, not a recency tilt.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the book-level net Sharpe (after the optimizer's transfer loss, weekly trading and the close-snapshot cost model) keeps the signal-level strength measured for the equal-theme composite (window A gross 1.68, net 1.39 at 8 bp per side; 10 of 11 recent phases positive; stress 0.48), whether it is spread across phases, and whether M0V or M0X add to M0. No public record covers this universe, cost model and window.
negative_experiments_checked: Registry check (263 directions): standalone refutations of earnings drift, insider clusters, net issuance, short volume, overnight persistence, intraday families and pure price-volume ranking (T-17/T-19) are readmitted only as book inputs. H-20260929-12, the only earlier hedged multi-factor attempt, died of a label/holding-return mismatch, fixed by the single return implementation (D2 unit test 4). The Stage 0 252-day beta hedge left realised beta 0.5-0.9, hence the risk model and the beta constraint. The Q2 strength came from shorting dilutive microcaps with borrow unmodelled, hence SE_t and borrow costs. Prior-work audit 2026-10-01 (reports/research/program/prior-work-audit-2026-10-01): 28 directions had a real long-short or same-pool effect killed by the standalone long-only unit; the T-19 GBDT ranking (stress RankIC t 3.1, illiquid tercile t 5.75) is the only directly reusable model asset, used here as M0X. Time-series factor momentum added nothing in our 2017-2026 data (difference t -1.4..0.1).
cost_and_execution_assumptions: As t20261001_book_v1 with amendment A1: signal after the close of t, fill at the close of t+1 (Alpaca time_in_force=cls, submitted before 15:50 ET); half-spread from cost model v1 at the 15:45 snapshot (open half-spreads are ~4.1x), square-root impact Y = 0.5 with accounting at initial_equity $1M, fees 0.5 bp per side, borrow 25 bp a year on all shorts (100 bp in the 2x check); F1 L = S <= 0.5E plus T-bills 1.0E; whole-share shorts on easy-to-borrow names or hedge ETFs. The closing auction has no quoted spread but has auction impact; the 15:45 proxy is checked in the two-week paper shakedown.
stop_condition: All 12 RF1 variants fail watch_recent: RF1 is refuted, no parameter is tuned, the next step is book v1.1 with the audit's S2 signals (MAX, 52-week high, Alpha158 FDR set, return-earnings-gap reversal, 13D) or the v2 text layer under a new contract. A paper or forward book stops on the hypotheses.md section 7 exit rules (63-session net Sharpe < -1.0, drawdown > 4.3% halves gross; drawdown > 8% or beta out of control for 5 sessions stops it).

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Reuse the T-20261001-08 close paths for RF_M0 and RF_M1 (no rerun); T-20261001-15 runs RF_M0V and RF_M0X x A/B/C x 5 offsets with the same runner and accounting replays, then evaluates every RF1 condition on window A, window B, phases P01..P10 and the stress diagnostic from the same daily series; placebo (100 seeds, net and gross) only for variants whose window-A median-offset net Sharpe is >= 0.87.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: Any RF1 variant meets every research_pass row (R1-R7) of hypotheses.md section 5 at the median offset (watch_recent rows for the lower tier), with R8 applied as a downgrade.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No RF1 variant reaches watch_recent; then RF1 is refuted and book v1.1 or v2 needs a new contract.
